# QR Code generator library

Unmodified C++ sources from Project Nayuki, version 1.8.0.

- Upstream: https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator
- Commit: `720f62bddb7226106071d4728c292cb1df519ceb`
- Files: `cpp/qrcodegen.cpp`, `cpp/qrcodegen.hpp`
- License: MIT, retained in both source headers and `LICENSE`.

DeskPort uses the module matrix for terminal rendering. No external QR encoder
process, network service, Qt display connection, or image plugin is required.
